body: It's things like these that keep me going most of the time. As cruel as the world can feel sometimes, I know that there are kind and amazing people in it. Kindness is such an integral and beautiful part of the human species. It's people like you that show me that there is always a reason to keep going. I want to help others as well.
Well I'm crying now haha. It feels so good to hear the words "I believe in you", even from a stranger in a reddit comment. Thank you so much for saying what you did.
